acceptanceCriteria: Without a subject, lexical rows are ordered by match strength, not a flat score.
A selected source file's paired test is admitted ahead of unrelated lexical tests within the limit.
The frozen retrieval evaluations do not regress, and the change is validated on a held-out repository whose cases were frozen before the fix ran against it.
body:
Observed in V1-0019 run-001 on go-chi/chi with the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate b967f6bb (binary sha256 baac3385...): UC-TASK-ORIENTATION FAILED with 3 treatment-only critical misses. Case b1c9ab47 (task `record response status when flushing`): `corvint context --task ... --limit 20` returned middleware/wrap_writer.go but not middleware/wrap_writer_test.go, while 10 unrelated *_test.go files filled the packet; plain git grep included it. Case 50ef4e4c (`Replace "interface{}" with "any"`) missed middleware/middleware_test.go and middleware/recoverer_test.go. Diagnosis on b1c9ab47^: the task names no file, so the subject-anchored slots (pair, reverse-import, reference, cochange, sibling) report subject-absent; one `test` row (score 700) and 19 `lexical` rows all at score 300 fill the packet, so lexical order among ties is not by match strength and the pair slot never runs for a lexical hit (internal/contextindex/taskcontext.go contextPairCap, contextTestCap). The preregistration forbids tuning the scored candidate, so the fix lands in a later candidate and is validated on a new held-out repository (owner answer 2026-09-27: spf13/cobra).

2026-09-28 reviewed local outcome: Local implementation de427c57 is independently reviewed on codex/bug-fix-batch, bound CEM 494689566f90609650ce93f9c0355deaba697c84. Focused context units, CLI TaskContext/SlotWeight/Eval, owning vet and requirement locators PASS; keyed completion and strict dogfood check PASS. The paired-source/test CLI regression fails before and passes after. Integration verified: PR #320 merged at e9a261d26bd5915e1c4a8d10519a6355b34c5946, reviewed head e09eed3a2d036341215c4537d5707939fdf7be3f is on origin/main, and all 11 CI checks PASS. Remaining: applicable frozen retrieval evaluation against its correct corpus and next immutable candidate/cobra qualification (criterion 3). Legacy testing/context-retrieval-goldens.json targets Beamfall and was not scored successfully against Corvint; this is not a passing evaluation. Ticket remains OPEN.
title: Task context without a subject scores every lexical row equally and never adds a selected file's paired test
